g.title: StudioV2
g.text: CARD ENGINE AI STUDIO V2 — ONE-PAGE ARCHITECTURE MAP

g.title: cluster_advisors
g.text: 1 — READ-ONLY SPECIALIST DIRECTORS • They recommend; they never implement

g.title: cluster_workflows
g.text: 2 — PRODUCTION SKILLS • Repeatable workflows with approvals and stop conditions

g.title: cluster_tools
g.text: 3 — EXECUTION CAPABILITIES • Tools and providers are not decision-makers

g.title: cluster_evidence
g.text: 4 — EVIDENCE GATES • 'Done' means proven, not merely compiled

g.title: lead
g.text: Understands intent • coordinates specialists • implements approved work

g.title: router->game
g.text: consult only when judgment is needed

g.title: memory
g.text: Canonical docs • generated references • playbooks • fixtures • reusable components
Every completed task asks: did we learn a rule worth preserving?

g.title: verdict->human
g.text: only when human judgment is required

g.title: portable
g.text: Studio Core + Phaser Pack + PixelLab Pack + project configuration
A coworker installs the workflow; Card Engine remains Project 001

g.title: memory->portable
g.text: extract only after it works in Card Engine
